name: Dolphin Browser
developer: MoboTap Inc. (majority-owned by Changyou, a Sohu subsidiary, since 2014)
hq: China (parent Changyou/Sohu); MoboTap's own location unverified
businessModel: Free app with sponsored shortcuts and ads (iOS reviewers report them) and optional in-app purchases on iOS; parent Changyou bought 51% in 2014
paidNote: iOS app lists optional in-app purchases
statusNote: Android app still gets sporadic bug-fix updates (12.4.2, Oct 2025 to Jan 2026 per mirrors, dates conflict); iOS app last updated Nov 2020; official site shows 2023 copyright

version.upstream: Android System WebView (Chromium); iOS uses WebKit

updateCadence: Irregular; the 12.x Android line moved 12.2.9 to 12.4.2 with minimal bug-fix notes, and iOS is dormant
pitch: Veteran Android/iOS browser known for gestures and voice search, now barely maintained.
summary: Dolphin is a long-running mobile browser from MoboTap with swipe gestures, Sonar voice search, sidebars and Dolphin Connect sync. The Android app still gets rare bug-fix updates; the iOS app has been dormant since 2020.
bestFor: Users on very old Android phones (app needs Android 4.1)
Fans of gesture and sidebar navigation on mobile
People who want a small WebView-based browser with speed dial
notFor: Privacy-conscious users, given past data leaks and missing iOS privacy labels
Anyone who wants regular feature or security updates from the app itself
iPhone users, since the iOS app has not been updated since 2020
Users who want modern tab, sync or extension features

pros.title: Gestures and Sonar
pros.detail: Swipe gestures, sidebars and voice search were the app's signature features and remain in the store listings.

pros.title: Small and light
pros.detail: The Android APK is about 17 MB and the app supports Android 4.1 and newer.

pros.title: Speed dial and sidebars
pros.detail: Quick access to bookmarks and options by swiping, plus speed dial for favorite sites.

pros.title: Cross-device sync option
pros.detail: Dolphin Connect syncs data across compatible devices, per the official site.

cons.title: Barely maintained
cons.detail: Changelogs say only 'fixed bugs'; the iOS app's last release was 10.0.6 on Nov 24, 2020.

cons.title: Privacy track record
cons.detail: In 2011 Dolphin HD was found sending visited URLs in plain text to a server, and reviewers report sponsored shortcuts being re-added.

cons.title: Stale marketing
cons.detail: The official site still advertises Flash support and shows a 2023 copyright and no privacy policy link.

cons.title: Weak ratings and sparse security info
cons.detail: The iOS app rates 2.7 from 579 ratings and has no privacy details; Android patching depends on System WebView.

faq.a: The Android build reached 12.4.2 with a minimal bug-fix note, but mirror dates conflict (Oct 2025 to Jan 2026). The iOS app's last update was Nov 2020.
MoboTap makes it, and Chinese gaming company Changyou (a Sohu subsidiary) bought 51% in 2014; current ownership was not re-confirmed.
Not by design. It had a 2011 URL-leak incident, and the iOS listing gives no privacy-practice details.

timeline.event: Dolphin launched on Android by MoboTap; Dolphin Browser HD followed in May 2010

privacy.telemetry: Not documented; iOS listing supplies no privacy-practice details

spec.patchLag: Depends on System WebView updates; app updates are sporadic

mouseGestures: Touch gesture browsing, the signature feature
